lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, thank you for calling, you are speaking with Sam. How can I help you today?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Hi Sam. I moved house last week and I need to change the shipping address on my order.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: No problem at all, I can update the shipping address for you. What is the new address?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: It is twelve River Road, Springfield.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you. I have changed the delivery address on your order to twelve River Road.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Brilliant, thank you. That was easy.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Glad I could help. Anything else?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: No thanks, have a nice day.
